Appendix E Diversity in High-Confidence Seeds
[id=A5.p1.1] Our Accuracy vs. Predicted Confidence pipeline in Section 5.2 conditions on high-confidence seeds (level 1). To verify that this selection does not collapse within-class diversity, we visualize the denoised samples per label generated from level 1 seeds and compare them with classifier-free guidance (CFG) targeting the same label.
(a) Within-class diversity from high-confidence (level 1) seeds under unconditional denoising (1010 samples per label).
(b) Within-class diversity under (conditional) classifier-free guidance (CFG) (with guidance scale =3=3) (1010 samples per label).
Figure 11: Diversity comparison between confidence-based selection and classifier-free guidance.
